title: Posting Standard for Coverage Credits on Repair and Emergency Service Calls Invoices
content:
**Line-level posting.** Coverage credits on a Repair and Emergency Service Calls invoice are posted against a specific charge line already on the invoice. They are never posted against the invoice as a whole.

**Protection contract coverage.** A warranty claim coverage line is posted for each payout of an approved protection contract claim, naming the claim and the line it pays. Payouts go to these lines:

| Payout of the approved claim | Line it is posted against |
|---|---|
| Labor payout | The failed task's repair labor line |
| Parts payout | The failed task's repair parts line |
| Refrigerant payout | The refrigerant line |
| Diagnostic payout | The diagnostic fee line |
| Premium payout | The after-hours premium line |

**Comfort Club coverage.** A plan repair coverage line is posted for each Comfort Club covered-repair draw, naming the agreement and the line it pays.

**Order on each line.** The order on each line is fixed. Discounts come first, protection contract coverage next, and Comfort Club covered repairs last. The sum of discounts and coverage on a line never exceeds the line's amount.

**Status gate.** A coverage credit is posted only to a call in completed or closed status. The status is read from the record of the same call.

**Customer share.** Whatever remains after coverage is owed by the customer.

## Worked example (hypothetical line)

A repair labor line of $400.00 carries a member repair discount of $40.00. An approved protection contract claim pays $300.00 of labor, and a Comfort Club covered-repair draw of $100.00 is available.

| Order | Applied to the line | Remaining on the line |
|---|---|---|
| Discount | $40.00 | $360.00 |
| Protection contract coverage | $300.00 | $60.00 |
| Comfort Club covered repair | $60.00 (the line's remainder; discounts and coverage never exceed the line) | $0.00 |
